accueil.titre: A care journey in Morocco, prepared with you
accueil.sous_titre: Duumvirat Business supports patients from Sub-Saharan Africa before, during and after their medical stay in Morocco: file review, guidance toward the right clinic, trip organisation, and presence by your side on the ground.
accueil.reassurance: We do not promise a medical outcome: we prepare every step so your stay runs under the best possible conditions.
accueil.histoire_titre: Why it pays to prepare ahead
accueil.cta_finale_titre: Ready to start your guidance request?
accueil.cta_finale_texte: Send us your recent medical report and a valid passport: we will review your file and get back to you.

services.intro: Support designed for every stage of your care journey in Morocco.

services_detail.intro: You have a care project in Morocco. We help you prepare your file, find suitable guidance, get the information you need, organise your stay and support you on the ground.

preparer.accroche: Reviewing the medical file and preparing the care project
points: Review of the medical report, test results, X-rays, MRIs or scans available
Taking into account treatments already followed and medical history
A teleconsultation with a healthcare professional can be arranged if the file provided is insufficient
Goal: avoid travelling with an incomplete file or without knowing which steps to take

orienter.accroche: Finding a suitable facility and facilitating the quote request
points: Guidance based on the condition, the specialty required, the necessary tests, the budget and, when possible, the preferred city
Facilitating the transfer of the file to the relevant care facility
Help understanding the different items on the quote: consultations, tests, procedures, hospitalisation, treatments
A medical quote remains an estimate, which may change depending on test results and medical decisions
orienter.avertissement: Duumvirat does not make diagnoses or decide on treatment. Medical guidance and therapeutic decisions remain the responsibility of healthcare professionals.

organiser.accroche: Accommodation, transport, appointments and the stay's schedule
points: Finding and booking accommodation suited to the length of the medical programme
Airport transfer and travel to healthcare facilities
Coordination of the different stages of the programme and appointments
Welcome on arrival in Morocco and help settling in, for patients who need it

accompagner.accroche: On-the-ground support and organisational follow-up after returning home
points: Support to appointments and transport to healthcare facilities during the stay
Coordination with the various contacts involved
Assistance with certain practical and administrative steps related to the stay
Remote organisational follow-up after the patient's return, when necessary and possible

services_detail.personnalise: Not all patients have the same needs: some come for a simple consultation or tests, others for a procedure requiring several days of hospitalisation, and others need more support because of their age, general condition or the complexity of their stay. Duumvirat adapts its organisation based on the medical issue, the patient's plan, the length of stay, the budget and the level of support needed.

parcours.intro: Ten steps, from first contact to follow-up after your return.

dossier.sans_compte_rendu_texte: Duumvirat Business can arrange a teleconsultation to gather what's needed to move forward.
